messages.author: b63e01cd28805f12
messages.subject: kde2d and stat_density2d
parts:
Hi community, 

The function of the MASS package kde2d uses axis-aligned bivariate Normal kernel, according http://www.inside-r.org/packages/cran/MASS/docs/kde2d, also used Defaults to Normal reference bandwidth 

the function stat_density2d that type of kernel used? 
What type of bandwidth used by default? 


Thank you for your valuable help

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: kde2d and stat_density2d
parts:
Hi Marta,

stat_density2d uses kde2d, passing named arguments x y and n, and
setting the lims argument to kde2d based on the scale limits. The "h"
argument of kde2d seems to be left at the default unless you pass it
in as a named argument. See
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/blob/b316892628ef31ec1d014e65a58d5c62f405ba15/R/stat-density-2d.r
for the code used.

Best,
Ista
